sources.extracted_facts: Strique is an agentic AI marketing platform and AI marketing OS for growth teams. It runs marketing work through one loop: plan the work, ship it, measure outcomes, and feed learnings into the next run. Brand values include measurable outcomes, closed-loop learning, human control for high-stakes actions, traceability, and practical autonomy. PostHog is the product and behavioral analytics source. GA4 is not used for Strique measurement. GSC is connected through Composio, and Google Ads Keyword Planner is available through Composio.

Keyword rows include ai marketing analytics mapped to product intent with directional volume 70, marketing automation reporting mapped to product intent with directional volume 50, and ai ad optimization mapped to product intent with directional volume 40. The requested secondary keyword closed-loop marketing was not found as an exact row in the local keyword file.

The keyword research summary was generated on 2026-06-29 for https://www.strique.io, target country United States, with 228 deduped universe rows, 150 prioritized rows, 226 Keyword Planner rows, and 0 GSC query rows in that summary artifact.

The URL inventory includes 63 public Strique URLs. Existing related pages include /blog/closing-the-loop, /blog/ai-ad-optimization-guide, /blog/ai-ad-analytics-platform-optimize-ad-spend-reduce-waste, /product, /integrations, and /customers.

Site checks show public crawl evidence, rendered browser evidence, performance evidence, keyword demand evidence, keyword intent grouping, GSC SERP expectation evidence, GSC measurement coverage, and GSC landing-page performance evidence. PostHog evidence is blocked in this artifact.

The content checklist requires one primary purpose, search intent match, natural keyword coverage, originality, evidence, useful headings, direct language, internal links, structured data, conversion fit, AI search readiness, and no visible AI artifacts.

The existing SEO automation draft describes the Strique loop as audit, map, prioritize, brief, ship with approval, measure, and learn. It also notes that PostHog is the product and behavioral analytics source, and that SEO work is not finished when impressions rise.

The existing authenticity log records the required content-seo-authenticity skill metadata, source-backed claims, detector_notes as an empty list, and the same brand, keyword, URL inventory, site checks, audit, and checklist source pattern used for Strique blog drafts.
